name: University of California, Davis
character: Located in California's Central Valley, the vast campus features a large rectangular Quad, extensive bicycle trails, angular metallic buildings, and a 100-acre arboretum with 4,000 tree specimens, Putah Creek, and Lake Spafford.

landmarks.name: the Quad
landmarks.quote: Towards the northeast end of campus is the Quad, a large rectangular field, which was the historic geographic center of campus.
landmarks.look: A large rectangular grassy field at the center of campus.

landmarks.name: Shields Library
landmarks.quote: The Quad remains the center of campus life, anchored to the north by the Memorial Union (student union), to the south by the Shields Library
landmarks.look: A plain university library building bordering the south side of a quad.

landmarks.name: UC Davis Arboretum
landmarks.quote: To the south side of the campus core is the 100-acre UC Davis Arboretum, which includes 3.5 miles of paved paths, 4,000 tree specimens
landmarks.look: A sprawling 100-acre wooded garden with paved paths and thousands of trees.

landmarks.name: Lake Spafford
landmarks.quote: the 100-acre UC Davis Arboretum, which includes 3.5 miles of paved paths, 4,000 tree specimens, Putah Creek and Lake Spafford.
landmarks.look: A calm lake surrounded by trees and paved paths in an arboretum.

landmarks.name: Wellman Hall
landmarks.quote: The northeast side of campus holds more of the core buildings that were built earlier in UC Davis's history, such as Wellman Hall
landmarks.look: An older, plain campus hall near the northeast corner of the quad.

landmarks.name: Mrak Hall
landmarks.quote: core buildings that were built earlier in UC Davis's history, such as Wellman Hall, Shields Library, Mrak Hall, and Hutchison Hall.
landmarks.look: An older, plain administrative hall with an egghead sculpture outside.

landmarks.name: C.N. Gorman Museum
landmarks.quote: Museums on campus include the C.N. Gorman Museum, specializing in indigenous and Native American art

landmarks.name: Manetti Shrem Museum of Art
landmarks.quote: and the Manetti Shrem Museum of Art, with a focus on local artists from the Bay Area Figurative Movement, Pop art and Funk art movements.
landmarks.look: A plain campus art museum building.
